projects.title: Doclify
projects.description: AI-powered CLI tool that automatically generates professional README documentation by analyzing a codebase
projects.longDescription: Doclify analyzes a codebase and automatically generates professional README documentation using fast, open-source LLMs via the Groq API — turning a manual documentation chore into a single command.

projects.title: Multi-Agentic-Blog-Generation
projects.description: Autonomous AI-powered blogging platform that generates, formats, and publishes technical articles
projects.longDescription: An autonomous blogging platform that generates, formats, and publishes high-quality technical articles using LangGraph multi-agent workflows and Groq LLMs, with automated deployment to a static website.

projects.title: self-healing-rag
projects.description: A RAG pipeline that critiques and retries its own answers, evaluated on a real SEC 10-K filing
projects.longDescription: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that critiques its own answers and retries when confidence is low, built and evaluated end-to-end on a real SEC 10-K filing to test answer reliability on dense financial documents.

projects.title: resilient-llm-gateway
projects.description: A middleware layer for LLM calls with retry, automatic failover, and circuit breaker logic
projects.longDescription: A resilience layer for production LLM applications, sitting in front of LLM calls to handle retries, automatic provider failover, and circuit breaking so downstream apps stay reliable under API instability.

projects.title: Heart-Disease-Prediction
projects.description: End-to-end ML project predicting heart disease risk using clinical data, with a real-time Flask app
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end machine learning project that predicts heart disease risk using clinical data, featuring multiple models, experiment tracking, and a Flask-based web application for real-time predictions.

projects.title: Diamond-Price-Prediction
projects.description: End-to-end ML project predicting diamond prices using regression models, with MLflow tracking
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end machine learning project that predicts diamond prices using regression models, with experiment tracking via MLflow and a Flask-based web application for real-time predictions.

projects.title: VisionStack
projects.description: Business growth analytics platform processing millions of records with PySpark and Databricks
projects.longDescription: A scalable big data pipeline built with PySpark and Databricks, processing millions of customer and product records from CSV, JSON, and Parquet sources into a unified analytics model, with SQL ETL workflows generating KPIs for sales trends, product performance, and customer segmentation.

projects.title: promo-segmentation-analytics
projects.description: Simulated customer segmentation and discount analytics using Python and Excel reporting
projects.longDescription: A customer segmentation and promotional discount analytics project, simulating customer behavior and reporting insights using Python, Matplotlib, and Excel-based reporting.

projects.title: southstar-ai-copilot
projects.description: An AI copilot project built in Python
projects.longDescription: An AI copilot project exploring assistant-style AI workflows and tooling, built in Python.

projects.title: self-tool-agent
projects.description: An AI agent project exploring self-directed tool use
projects.longDescription: An agent project exploring self-directed tool selection and use, built in Python.

projects.title: strategiz-agent
projects.longDescription: A Python-based AI agent project focused on strategic planning and decision workflows.
